name: styxx
summary: Instruments that check what AI agents claim against committed bytes. diffgate reads an agent's PR summary against its diff and reports by default: the claim "an agent's PR summary cannot lie about its diff" is not yet true of this instrument on real-world data (EXTERNAL-1: precision 0.23, 23 of 100 sampled accusations upheld, styxx 7.47.0, against a 0.95 floor). OATH certificates check the numbers they extract from a document against committed receipts. Base install: numpy, scikit-learn.
